name: podman-quadlet-service
description: Install a containerized service as a rootless Podman Quadlet systemd unit with a deliberate lifecycle (daemon, on-demand, socket-activated, scheduled job), graceful stop, hardened-by-default security, image needs profiling (ports, capabilities, egress, resource sizing from inspection and research), default-deny egress, digest-pinned images, podman secrets, healthchecks and reverse-proxy placement, with generated runbooks.
